description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key information from a bank account opening permit, such as the account number, legal representative, issuing bank, approval number, company name, and permit number
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别银行开户许可证中的账号、法定代表人、开户银行、核准号、企业名称、编号等关键信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-bank-account-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB17liGda67gK0jSZFHXXa9jVXa-1375-1000.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBankAccountLicense

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
